title: Oxygen Concentration Flammability Thresholds of Selected Aerospace Materials Considered for the Constellation Program
authors: D. B. Hirsch, J. H. Williams, S. A. Harper, H. Beeson (NASA White Sands Test Facility) and M. D. Pedley (NASA Johnson Space Center)
venue: 2nd IAASS Conference, Space Safety in a Global World, Chicago, 14 to 16 May 2007
rights: NASA Technical Reports Server: Distribution Limits: Public. Copyright: Work of the US Gov. Public Use Permitted.
text_note: NTRS-20070018178.txt is the text of the PDF, extracted with the Python library pypdf 7.1.0, unedited. The build reads every threshold from this text; none is typed by hand.
table: Table 2. Upward Limiting Oxygen Indices (ULOI) and Maximum Oxygen Concentrations when Self-Extinguishment Occurs (MOC) for Selected Materials at 70.1 kPa Total Pressures
pressure_kpa_quote: The oxygen concentration flammability thresholds were determined at a fixed total pressure of 70.1 kPa.

quotes.method: Flammability threshold testing in quiescent environments was conducted following NASA STD 6001 Test 1 procedures.
quotes.test: The method is an upward flame propagation test in a quiescent environment using a well-defined igniter flame at the bottom of a vertically mounted sample.
quotes.pass: A material passes this test if the vertical burn length is less than 15.2 cm and there is no evidence of transfer of burning debris
quotes.moc: The MOC was the oxygen concentration where at least three samples passed the NASA-STD-6001 burning criteria of less than 15.2 cm burn length
quotes.below: The materials reported with ULOIs and MOCs less than 30 burned at least 15.2 cm in 30 % oxygen, while the materials reported with ULOIs and MOCs larger than 40 burned less than 15.2 cm in 40 % oxygen.
quotes.conclusion: The specific materials that will be used in LSAM have not yet been selected, so additional testing will certainly be required; but the results are extremely promising.
quotes.step: the oxygen concentration was lowered in 1 % steps

config_quotes.J configuration: The samples were tested in a “J” configuration.
config_quotes.15 degrees from vertical: The samples were tested at 15 degrees from vertical.
